4.text: Then he flung the soul at it. “Oh, oh, oh!” sighed the boy, and then sat up on the skin.

19.text: and, instead of that, orders the mother or the sister of the patient, or, in

25.text: Another method of shamanistic treatment of diseases may be called

26.text: “magic surgery.” In this the shaman pretends to operate on the diseased

27.text: part of the body and to set it right, removing the pus and the bad blood,

28.text: and sometimes even recasting the whole limb. The shaman acts in a way

33.text: Some of the rubbing and sucking has the character of massage, especially in

34.text: the treatment of swellings and bruises. The shaman often produces a beetle,
